verdict.rationale: SSH access with your own keys and root control is a fair question for a GPU compute platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack only covers GPU selection, containerized Functions, Sandboxes, SDKs and a CLI. Nothing documents SSH access, bringing your own keys, or root-level control of the environment.

support.subject: As a developer, I can SSH into my GPU instance with my own keys and get root-level control of the environment
